messages:
Priya: Pushed a new Figma for the Embeddings preview + rerank export flow. Compact rows + export sidecar. link in thread.
Devin: Thx. Quick scan: sidecar export idea (metadata section that stays with file) looks good. ensure `model_variant` and `rerank_params` are present.
Marco: UX nit: the preview diff toggle (before / after rerank) should be inline, not a modal. users want quick compare. :left_right_arrow: 
Lina: Accessibility: action icons need descriptive labels. e.g., `aria-label="Pin result"` and `aria-pressed` for pin state. Also don't rely on color alone for moved-up/down indicators.
Theo: Copy: change CTA from "Download CSV" to "Export results" when multiple formats are available. show small chevron to expand format choices.
a11y-bot: Auto-scan result: heatmap legend contrast fails for small labels. Recommend swapping to high-contrast palette `#b2182b`->`#2166ac` and adding hatch pattern fallback. Table headers missing `scope` attribute.
Devin: Good. For export schema we propose top-level JSON like: `{"metadata":{...},"results": [...]}` and CSV headers: `id,original_index,similarity_score,rerank_score,rank_delta,source,notes`.
Marco: Performance: prerender heatmap as SVG sprites for each score bucket to reduce DOM. Also virtualize rows but provide "Prepare export" button for very large batches.
Lina: Keyboard: add single-key shortcuts: `n`/`p` to navigate rows, `e` to expand, `x` to export selected. Document them in a keyboard help modal.
Theo: Progress UX: if export will take >3s show determinate progress when we know total rows; otherwise show spinner + soft cancel. Announce final status with `role="status" aria-live="polite"`.
qa-bot: QA checklist suggestion: 1) export payload includes metadata keys exactly as design doc; 2) keyboard shortcuts work in screenreader mode; 3) exported CSV loads in Excel without corrupting json-escaped fields.
Priya: Also add a small cost hint next to CTA showing estimated token count & cost range — opt-in telemetry only.
Marco: Mobile: primary CTA truncated on small widths. drop label to "Export" under 360px and show full label in tooltip.
Devin: I'll update Figma: add inline diff, sidecar metadata mockup, keyboard help, and new color ramps. Will post new link later today.
product-bot: Note: ask PM to confirm telemetry opt-in language for cost hint before release.
Lina: I'll run a quick keyboard and screenreader pass after the update.
Priya: Thanks — acceptance checklist to include: (a) a11y pass, (b) export metadata present, (c) deterministic progress for known workloads.
Devin: Great. Wrapping up — leaving a TODO comment in Figma for export schema and keyboard modal. :white_check_mark:
